To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
DMAb was effective in the prevention and treatment of osteoporosis, and the effect was greater when compared with bisphosphonatetreatment in PO patients, but not in those with RA.
DMAb treatment was effective in all three groups, but the onset was slower in the PO with RA and the effect in preventing increased bone turnover was smaller in PO with RA and PO with RA and GC.
denosumab has a beneficial effect in preventing osteoporosis in RA and RA + glucocorticoid patients.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of denosunab on osteoporosis and the effect of denousmab on RA patients.
the effect of denosunab on bone metabolism in RA and RA  +  GC patients, which is evaluated by radial DXA.
the effect of denosubmab on osteoporosis and the effect of deno-sumab on osteoporotic patients with RA and GC.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
denosumab is effective for the treatment of osteoporosis in RA patients, and it is especially effective for RA +  GC patients, who are at risk for osteoporosis.
denosumab is effective for osteoporosis treatment in RA patients, including those with RA receiving GCs, as assessed by radial DXA.
the effect of denosubam was greater in PO patients than in RA and GC-treated RA patients.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
denosumab is effective for osteoporosis in PO patients.
the therapeutic effect of denusumab is better than bisphosphonated in osteoporosis patients.
the effect of DMAbs on bone metabolism is greater in PO patients than in RA patients, and that the effect of denosunab is greater than that of bisphosphonats.
The main takeaway from our work is that
denosumab is a safe and effective treatment for osteoporosis in RA and RA  +  GC patients.
denosumab is effective for osteoporosis patients with rheumatoid arthrits.
the use of denosumub in osteoporosis patients with rheumatoid ahritis and/or glucocortocoids should be considered.
